column2: [intro]
In the morning, I rise like a star,
With my hair set to shine through the fog afar.
I put on my shades, ready to face
The day's adventures, whatever they embrace.
In my life, it's all a movie scene,
Adventures that make me feel so serene.
I only organize things like in a film,
It's my way of showing my thrill.
I stroll through the streets like a cowboy grand,
My dog by my side, my loyal band.
I make encounters, wild exchanges so neat,
In my mind, it's like living on a grand street.
In my life, it's all a movie scene,
Adventures that make me feel so serene.
I only organize things like in a film,
It's my way of showing my thrill.
